headline: SDP @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.07 at TEX 4.06, with a projected total of 8.13. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: SDP moved +0.69 runs while TEX moved -0.14, changing the projected margin by +0.83 runs. The projected total climbed +0.67, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -8.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jacob deGrom has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Samad Taylor, Fernando Tatis Jr., Jake Burger, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ty France because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
